scope.profile: Generated C repair profile through scripted ACP and active repair validation
scope.coverage: The scripted peer writes a multibyte candidate of exactly 4,096 UTF-8 bytes, submits a write containing a lone UTF-16 surrogate, requires a protocol refusal, and reads the target back to confirm the candidate is unchanged. The active loop requires a receipt-bound injected validator to observe the exact candidate bytes/digest. The retained receipt and assessment hashes are linked; the candidate is rejected by the sentinel validator, while accepted source/head remain unchanged and pending state clears. The same run also covers existing exact-candidate patch-byte, filesystem read/write, and source-file grant retry cases.
qualificationLimits: local scripted ACP only; the validator is injected and does not qualify production validation under #236
